name: Yuandian Web / H5
purpose: Render the same product loop as the miniapp on the official website without importing miniapp UI code.
designRule: Keep brand language aligned with the miniapp, but implement Web layout, routing, responsive behavior, and export flows inside apps/web only.

primaryEntries.label: 首页总览
primaryEntries.job: Show the whole learning loop at a glance and route users into the next best action.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Desktop gets a left rail plus one main action panel; mobile gets a compact tab-like launch board.

primaryEntries.label: 上传资料
primaryEntries.job: Classify talent reports, grades, wrong questions, school feedback, and parent notes.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use larger drop zones, material cards, and a right-side evidence checklist.

primaryEntries.label: 个性化报告
primaryEntries.job: Explain evidence, talent-method fit, learning plan, and PDF export.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use report chapters, visual evidence panels, and sticky export/share actions.

primaryEntries.label: AI私教
primaryEntries.job: Start with the first Socratic question and keep the answer-safe tutoring boundary.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a two-column tutor workspace: dialogue on the left, evidence and next action on the right.

primaryEntries.label: 复习游戏
primaryEntries.job: Validate memory, transfer, and wrong-cause repair through lightweight game loops.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use one active challenge per screen, with progress, streak, and transfer prompts around it.

primaryEntries.label: 家长中心
primaryEntries.job: Summarize evidence, reassurance, parent question, and next step.
primaryEntries.webAdaptation: Use a decision dashboard: what we know, what changed, what to do tonight.
